title: Edit a config file on a server
prompt: On my server {{ssh}}, change the app's port from 8000 to 8080 in ~/app/config.ini. Leave everything else in the file as it is.

checks.equals:
[server]
host = 0.0.0.0
port = 8080
workers = 4

[db]
port = 5432
name = shop

notes: Two `port` keys: only the [server] one may change.
